meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: Claude 会系统性地把项目中每一个源代码文件完整读一遍,文件太大时分页读取,以便开工前对整个代码库有深入了解。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新项目、进入不熟悉的代码库,或说出“学习代码库”“读代码库”等指令时触发。

say.text: 先把这个项目的代码库完整读一遍。
say.note: Claude 会从头到尾读每个源文件。

say.text: 开始新项目前,先把所有源文件过一遍。
say.note: 它会对整个代码库建立认识。

say.text: 学习这个代码库,我好开始工作。
say.note: Claude 会先通读所有源代码。

howto.what_en: Claude systematically reads every source file in the project in full, paging through large files with offset/limit, to build a deep understanding of the codebase before work starts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", etc.

say_en.note: Claude reads every source file in full.

say_en.text: Before we start, go through all source files.
Learn this codebase so I can begin.
